thread:
maya: Hey all 1 quick follow-up to the all-hands Q&A about hybrid & offsite logistics. Dropping concrete answers and next steps here so it's easy to reference.

jordan: Perfect, thanks. Two quick ones: are we still doing the $350 home-office stipend, and can managers pre-approve desk purchases?

maya: Yes, $350 one-time stipend remains. Managers can pre-approve larger purchases (desk/chair) if they document business need in People-ops portal. Submit receipts after purchase.

sam: Clarify the guest policy for the offsite evening social  can people bring +1s?

leah: Managers may approve one guest for the social event only. Company covers the group ticket; travel/hotel for guests is employee/manager responsibility unless pre-approved. If someone needs an exception, tag me.

vivian: A question on travel approvals: do we still need manager + finance sign-off for non-standard expenses? Example: upgraded seat for medical reasons.

maya: For medical/ADA upgrades, submit via the travel form and tag People-ops. Finance will expedite approval; these do not need manager + finance if accompanied by a short justification and a People-ops note.

jordan: Hoteling in SF: we've seen recurring meetings occupy rooms whole days. Are recurring blocks still allowed?

leah: Recurring bookings are allowed but limited to 50% of the weekly block per team during peak hours (811am, 26pm). If you need more, request a multi-day block through facilities@redwood.com with justification.

ops-bot: Reminder: Offsite RSVP + dietary form closes 2026-07-12 23:59 UTC.

vivian: Visa support for international attendees  what's the timeline and required docs?

maya: Facilities coordinates visas. Submit passport scan (expiry >=6 months), full name as in passport, job title, and travel dates to Leah by 2026-07-02. We cover standard processing and expedited fees for covered attendees.

sam: Expense tool check: contractors confused about Concur vs Expensely. Which to use?

leah: Expensely is the default system for all travel/expenses now. Contractors should mark "Contractor" in their profile when submitting. If a contract specifies otherwise, follow the contract and flag Finance.

jordan: Cancellation/no-show fees  any appeal window? A teammate was charged last week due to a flight cancelation.

maya: Appeal window is 48 hours after the booking end. Submit an appeal to facilities@redwood.com with flight change proof; we'll waive fees for verified emergencies/force majeure.

vivian: Will there be quiet rooms for deep work during the offsite? Some need heads-down time.

maya: Yes  two quiet rooms reserved during the offsite. Booking links will be posted in the schedule and opened 7 days before the event.

leah: Action items: I'll post a short travel & expenses FAQ based on this thread and the all-hands notes; Maya will attach the booking windows and guest policy to the all-hands doc; Facilities will publish locker sign-up details and recurring booking rules.

jordan: Awesome, thanks. I'll share with my team.

maya: Thanks folks. Ping here for anything else and we'll keep the doc updated. :slightly_smiling_face:
